extracted.intended_audience: general readers and aspiring writers seeking information about Stephen King's book and his advice on the craft
extracted.subtask_description: Summarize and extract the craft-focused guidance and evaluative points that Stephen King presents in On Writing: A Memoir of the Craft, as reported by the Wikipedia article. The page describes the book's sections and the specific aspects of writing King emphasizes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Take writing seriously
rubrics_metrics.description: King urges the reader to take writing and his advice seriously.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mentioned in the "What Writing Is" section — King reintroduces himself and urges readers to take writing and his advice seriously (the book's exhortational stance toward craft).

rubrics_metrics.name: Writing as telepathy
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented in the "What Writing Is" section; the comparison frames writing as transmitting ideas clearly from writer to reader (an implicit criterion: clarity of communication).

rubrics_metrics.name: Toolbox — English mechanics
rubrics_metrics.description: The 'Toolbox' section discusses English mechanics and their role in writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Toolbox emphasizes practical mechanics that a writer needs to control; the Wikipedia summary identifies this section as focused on mechanical skills rather than high-level theory.

rubrics_metrics.name: Importance of vocabulary, grammar and style
rubrics_metrics.description: King discusses the importance of vocabulary, grammar and style in writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicitly listed in the Wikipedia summary of the 'Toolbox' section — these are presented as core mechanical and stylistic elements writers should develop and attend to.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of literary description
rubrics_metrics.description: The book includes an example of literary description.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mentioned in the 'What Writing Is' section — the presence of an example implies instruction to develop descriptive technique (showing rather than telling, illustrative demonstration of craft).

rubrics_metrics.name: Advice on dialogue and plot
rubrics_metrics.description: King offers advice on dialogue and plot.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers (e.g., Associated Press) specifically praised King's advice about dialogue and plot as 'solid', indicating these are named, substantive topics in his craft guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consistency in work habits and environment
rubrics_metrics.description: King describes his work habits and environment and urges that consistency in those areas can be conducive to good writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: As noted in reviews cited on the page, King 'describ[es] his work habits and environment urging that consistency in those areas can be conducive to good writing' — a prescriptive recommendation about routine and discipline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Draw on personal experience to inform writing
rubrics_metrics.description: King narrates events in his life that contributed to his development as a writer and uses personal history as material/instruction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The 'C.V.' section highlights life events (early exposure to writing, early attempts to be published, relationships, family death, substance abuse) that influenced his writing — modeling how personal biography can shape craft and subject matter.
